title: Play-cost modal mislabels multi-unit sacrifice variants for Commander Ledros
expected: modals.js:147-161 — describePlayVariant only branches on m.params.sacrificeId (singular); any paidAdditionalCost variant without it falls through to `label: 'Play + Accelerate', detail: '${baseCost} + ${extra} — enters ready'` where extra defaults to 'additional cost' when no additionalCostSpec. The engine enumerator at play-unit.ts:693-702 emits Ledros kill-any-number variants with `sacrificeIds: subset` and only adds `sacrificeId` when subset.length === 1, so every multi-unit subset (4 of them with 3 killable units: 3 pairs + 1 triple) renders identically as 'Play + Accelerate — 6 + additional cost — enters ready'.
observed: Every variant with sacrificeIds.length>=2 renders as 'Play + Accelerate — 6 + additional cost — enters ready' (4 identical buttons at order=2 with 3 friendly units); describePlayVariant in public/js/gameplay/render/modals.js only handles single sacrificeId and falls through to the Accelerate label. Clicking one still executes the correct multi-kill move and Ledros enters exhausted.
